capabilities: Chat with vault notes through local LLM servers or CLI subprocesses
Retrieve relevant notes with an on-device BM25 index
Switch models and reasoning effort with slash commands
Show retrieved sources as clickable wikilinks under each reply
Append or download assistant replies into vault notes
extras: Warns that the on-disk BM25 index can reach hundreds of MB and gives per-service exclusion instructions for Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Syncthing, Dropbox, and git. LM Studio API keys are stored in plain text in plugin data; assistant output written to notes is always sanitized. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with an LLM about your notes, whether fully offline or through an existing CLI-based AI subscription.

relations.evidence: Talks to any server that implements the OpenAI /chat/completions SSE protocol — LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp
Spawns the local claude CLI binary.
Spawns the local codex CLI (codex exec --json).

requires.name: LM Studio (or another OpenAI-compatible local server), or the claude / codex CLI

summary: Vault chat assistant that answers questions about your notes using local OpenAI-compatible LLM servers or the Claude Code and Codex CLIs.
